_doc: Shipped trigger-handling table (code root; do not edit, it is replaced on upgrade). A trigger term matched by a kind below is handled by that kind instead of sending the whole card. Your own tables override kinds of the same name, nearer wins: <data root>/atoms-custom/trigger-handling.json, <org_root>/.claude/atoms-custom/trigger-handling.json, <project_root>/.claude/atoms-custom/trigger-handling.json; "enabled": false removes one. Format: TECH.md, Appendix A5.1 stage 3.

kinds.name: common-short-ascii
kinds.note: A short English term that at least 5 cards in the same layer list as a trigger: on its own it sends only the card's title line.

kinds.name: common-short-cjk
kinds.note: A one- or two-character non-English term that at least 5 cards in the same layer list as a trigger: on its own it sends only the card's title line.
